# AirFone

> AirFone is being built as a self-serve AI call center for Nepali businesses. It is being designed so a business will be able to teach an AI agent about itself (by talking, pasting a website link, connecting a Facebook page, or showing photos and videos), test it by calling a demo number, and then let it take real customer calls. The agent is being designed to answer questions about prices, availability, opening hours and services in Nepali, and to say so when it doesn't know an answer instead of making one up.

- For: shops, online stores, clinics and hospitals, schools, restaurants
- Contact: info@airfone.app, +977 985-1343348
- App: https://app.airfone.app
